title: MMAP: Multimodal Missing-Aware Pretraining for Longitudinal Alzheimer's Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.26617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clinical decision making heavily relies on predicting the disease progression trajectory by seeking to understand patient's health status which is characterised by multimodal medical data. AI holds great potential for learning useful representations from multimodal medical data to predict disease progression and aid clinical decision making. However, development of predictive AI models is constrained by missing modalities and incomplete tabular data frequently occurring in medical datasets. In addition, disease labels alone may only provide limited supervisory signals for learning representations from high-dimensional multimodal data. Here, we present MMAP, a novel Multimodal Missing-aware Alignment Pretraining method for learning image-tabular representations from incomplete data. translated_title: MMAP：面向纵向阿尔茨海默病预测的多模态缺失感知预训练
translated_abstract: 临床决策在很大程度上依赖于通过理解患者的健康状况来预测疾病进展轨迹，而患者的健康状况由多模态医疗数据所刻画。人工智能在从多模态医疗数据中学习有用的表示以预测疾病进展并辅助临床决策方面具有巨大潜力。然而，预测型AI模型的开发受到医疗数据集中经常出现的模态缺失和不完整表格数据的限制。此外，仅凭疾病标签可能只能为从高维多模态数据中学习表示提供有限的监督信号。在本文中，我们提出了MMAP，一种新颖的多模态缺失感知对齐预训练方法，用于从不完整数据中学习图像-表格联合表示。其中，图像编码器通过高效的sigmoid对比学习结合生成式重建进行预训练，表格编码器则构建于表格数据基础之上。
tldr: 提出了MMAP方法，一种多模态缺失感知的对齐预训练框架，通过sigmoid对比学习与生成式重建从不完整的图像和表格数据中学习联合表示，用于阿尔茨海默病的纵向进展预测。
en_tdlr: MMAP is a novel multimodal missing-aware alignment pretraining method that learns image-tabular representations from incomplete data via efficient sigmoid contrastive learning combined with generative reconstruction, enabling longitudinal Alzheimer's disease prediction.
